description_en: Annual greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by source.
description_ms: Pelepasan gas rumah hijau (GHG) tahunan mengikut sumber.
methodology_en: Official data on GHG emissions is compiled by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability (NRES) for Malaysia's national greenhouse gas inventory, following the 2006 Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, and reported to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). Data up to 2021 is as submitted by Malaysia to the UNFCCC in the Common Reporting Tables accompanying its First Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1) in December 2024, with emissions of all gases converted to CO₂ equivalent using the 100-year global warming potentials of the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (AR5). The GHG emissions data is derived from multiple sectors including energy, industrial processes and product use, agriculture, waste, as well as land use, land-use change, and forestry (LULUCF). LULUCF data reflects both emissions and removals based on land management practices, contributing to the net emissions calculations.
methodology_ms: Statistik rasmi pelepasan GHG dirangka oleh Kementerian Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Sekitar (NRES) bagi inventori gas rumah hijau nasional Malaysia, mengikut Garis Panduan Panel Antara Kerajaan Mengenai Perubahan Iklim (IPCC) 2006 untuk Inventori Gas Rumah Hijau Nasional, dan dilaporkan kepada Konvensyen Rangka Kerja Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu mengenai Perubahan Iklim (UNFCCC). Data sehingga 2021 adalah sebagaimana yang dikemukakan oleh Malaysia kepada UNFCCC dalam Jadual Pelaporan Bersama (Common Reporting Tables) yang mengiringi Laporan Ketelusan Dwitahunan Pertama (BTR1) Malaysia pada Disember 2024, dengan pelepasan semua gas ditukar kepada CO₂ setara menggunakan potensi pemanasan global 100 tahun Laporan Penilaian Kelima IPCC (AR5). Data pelepasan GHG berpunca dari pelbagai sektor termasuk tenaga, proses industri dan penggunaan produk, pertanian, sisa, serta guna tanah, perubahan guna tanah, dan perhutanan (LULUCF). Data LULUCF mencerminkan pelepasan dan penyingkiran berdasarkan amalan pengurusan tanah, menyumbang kepada pengiraan pelepasan bersih.
caveat_en: Values for 2022 and 2023 are estimates and may be revised when the national inventory for those years is published. LULUCF, and therefore net emissions, are not available for 2022 and 2023. Figures follow the Common Reporting Tables and may differ from the summary tables printed in the BTR1 report.
caveat_ms: Nilai bagi 2022 dan 2023 adalah anggaran dan mungkin disemak semula apabila inventori nasional bagi tahun-tahun tersebut diterbitkan. LULUCF, dan oleh itu pelepasan bersih, tidak tersedia bagi 2022 dan 2023. Angka adalah mengikut Jadual Pelaporan Bersama dan mungkin berbeza daripada jadual ringkasan yang dicetak dalam laporan BTR1.
publication_en: [Malaysia's First Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1)](https://www.nres.gov.my/ms-my/pustakamedia/Penerbitan/MALAYSIA%20FIRST%20BIENNIAL%20TRANSPARENCY%20REPORT%20(BTR1).pdf) under the UNFCCC, published by NRES.
publication_ms: [Laporan Ketelusan Dwitahunan Pertama (BTR1) Malaysia](https://www.nres.gov.my/ms-my/pustakamedia/Penerbitan/MALAYSIA%20FIRST%20BIENNIAL%20TRANSPARENCY%20REPORT%20(BTR1).pdf) di bawah UNFCCC, diterbitkan oleh NRES.

fields.name: date
fields.description_en: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 since the data is at annual frequency
fields.description_ms: [Tarikh] Tarikh dalam format YYYY-MM-DD, dengan MM-DD diberi nilai 01-01 kerana data pada frekuensi tahunan

fields.name: source
fields.description_en: [Categorical] Either total emissions excluding LULUCF ('total'), net emissions including LULUCF ('net'), or the source of emissions ('energy', 'industrial_processes', 'agriculture', 'waste', 'lulucf'). It should be noted that although LULUCF values can, in principle, be positive (representing emissions) or negative (representing removals), the values for Malaysia are all negative.
fields.description_ms: [Kategori] Sama ada pelepasan keseluruhan tidak termasuk LULUCF ('total'), pelepasan bersih termasuk LULUCF ('net'), atau sumber pelepasan ('energy', 'industrial_processes', 'agriculture', 'waste', 'lulucf'). Harus diingati bahawa walaupun nilai LULUCF secara prinsipnya boleh positif (mewakili pelepasan) atau negatif (mewakili penyingkiran), nilai bagi Malaysia adalah semua negatif.

fields.name: emissions
fields.description_en: [Float] The amount of GHG emissions in gigagrams (Gg) of CO₂ equivalent (CO₂e).
fields.description_ms: [Apung] Jumlah pelepasan GHG dalam gigagram (Gg) CO₂ setara (CO₂e).
